hero.subtitle: Hand-cut steaks, tomahawk chops, and our signature ribs off the grill, poured alongside a curated wine list in Nusa Dua, Bali.

whatsOn.heading: What's On at Mr Bob
whatsOn.subheading: Live music nights, food off the grill, and the kind of bar energy that makes a Nusa Dua evening feel deliberate.

cards.schedule: Every Mon, Wed & Sat, 7 PM Onwards
cards.title: Live Music Nights
cards.detail: Live music every Monday (I Love Monday), Wednesday (Oldies Night), and Saturday (Country Night), from 7 PM.

cards.title: Pork Knuckle for Two
cards.detail: 1.1kg deep fried pork knuckle for two, served with mashed potatoes, sauteed vegetables, bean sauce, and pork gravy, plus two small Singaraja beers included.

whatsOn.ctaText: Planning a night out with a group? Let us set the table for your event.

welcome.body: Mr Bob Bar and Grill is built around the fire: hand-cut steaks, slow-cooked pork ribs, and show-stopping tomahawk chops, matched with a wine list chosen to go the distance with every cut. Pull up a seat at the bar or a table for the night in Tanjung Benoa, Nusa Dua, and let the grill do the talking.
welcome.quote: Real charcoal, real portions, real hospitality. That's the whole menu, really.

wineShop.eyebrow: Cheapest Wine Selection in Nusa Dua
wineShop.heading: Wine Shop
wineShop.body: Our wine shop is stocked with the best-priced selection around Nusa Dua, but what's on the shelf changes with availability, so there's no fixed list to browse online. Come by the restaurant and see what we've got pouring.

shuttle.heading: Complimentary Shuttle Around Nusa Dua
shuttle.body: Staying nearby? We're glad to offer a complimentary shuttle for guests staying within the Nusa Dua area, just let us know when you reserve your table.

recognition.heading: Recognition
recognition.body: Mr Bob Bar and Grill is the #1-rated restaurant in Tanjung Benoa, Nusa Dua on Tripadvisor, recognized with the Tripadvisor Travelers' Choice Award, placing us among the top 10% of restaurants worldwide, along with a Ctrip Gourmet List Certificate of Excellence, recognition we're genuinely proud of, and a reflection of the care we put into every plate and every guest.
recognition.ctripDesc: Recognized by Ctrip for consistently great food and genuine hospitality.
recognition.tripadvisorDesc: Reviews from millions of Tripadvisor travelers place this winner in the top 10% worldwide.

testimonials.heading: An Experience Worth Sharing
testimonials.intro: From the first plate off the grill to the last set of the night, guests keep coming back for the steaks, the ribs, the wine list, and the atmosphere that comes alive every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday.

hero.title: Built Around the Fire
hero.subtitle: The story behind Mr Bob Bar and Grill: steaks, ribs, tomahawk, wine, and live music.

ourStory.heading: Our Story
ourStory.body: Mr Bob Bar and Grill was built for people who take their steak seriously. Hand-cut cuts, real charcoal, and a wine list chosen to match every plate, served in a room that's just as at home with a quiet dinner as it is with a night full of live music.

featureRows.title: Hand-Cut, Fire-Grilled
featureRows.desc: Every steak, rack of ribs, and tomahawk chop is hand-cut and grilled over real fire. No shortcuts, no compromises on the char that makes a steakhouse worth the trip.

featureRows.title: A Bar Built to Match
featureRows.desc: From our house wine by the glass to signature cocktails and a full spirits list, the bar is built to stand up to the grill.

featureRows.title: A Room That Comes Alive
featureRows.desc: Every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday, live music turns dinner into a night out. Whether you're here for a quiet meal or the full evening, the room is built for both.

quoteBlock.line1: Welcome to Mr Bob Bar and Grill.
quoteBlock.line2: It's our pleasure to put a great steak, a good glass of wine, and a night of live music in front of you.
quoteBlock.line3: Thank you for choosing to spend your evening with us.

closingCta.heading: Pull Up a Seat
closingCta.body: Come taste what's on the grill and see why guests keep coming back for our live music nights.
